question: EOS-01 is a:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satellite launched by India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **EOS-01** is an Earth Observation Satellite launched by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• The satellite was launched on **7 November 2020** from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) SHAR, Sriharikota.
 
• EOS-01 is intended for applications in **agriculture, forestry and disaster management support**.
 
• It was launched aboard the PSLV-C49 rocket, which also carried nine customer satellites from foreign countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Earth Observation Satellites (EOS)**

 
 
• These satellites are primarily used for monitoring and managing the Earth’s resources.
 
• They provide critical data for weather forecasting, agriculture, forestry, and disaster management.
 
• EOS satellites can capture high-resolution images of the Earth's surface.
 
 
 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**
 
 
• ISRO is the space agency of the Government of India, headquartered in Bengaluru.
 
• Founded in 1969, ISRO is responsible for space research and the development of satellite technology.
 
• It has launched numerous satellites for various applications including communication, navigation, and earth observation.
 
 
 
• **PSLV (Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle)**
 
 
• PSLV is a third-generation launch vehicle of India.
 
• It is the first Indian launch vehicle to be equipped with liquid stages.
 
• PSLV has a high success rate and has been used to launch satellites into various orbits including geostationary and sun-synchronous.
